title: Auth, Auditing & Supply-Chain Hygiene
objectives: Wire session/JWT middleware with RBAC checks
Log security events without logging secrets

examples.name: rbac.js

exercise.prompt: Mark each SAFE or RISKY: "lockfile committed", "npm audit in CI", "pinned major versions", "secrets in .env committed to git", "token value logged on auth failure".
hints: Lockfiles + audits + pinning tame the supply chain.
Committed secrets and logged tokens are incidents waiting to happen.

options: server-side on every route, independent of what the UI hides
questions.explanation: Hiding a button is UX; the API check is the actual security boundary.

options: make installs reproducible — same versions everywhere, auditable
questions.explanation: Reproducibility is what makes audits and upgrades meaningful.
